- Do not pin `httpx` to 0.23; it broke the Stripe client.

- The `search_vectors_tenant_document_idx` failure was a missing test-database migration, not an insertion bug.

- Do not use sandbox payment host `sbx-pay-a`; it is shut down and serves stale fixtures. Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`.

## Recent work
- CSV exports now explicitly use UTF-8. Unicode (`Zoë`, `東京`) was manually verified; Ruff, `git diff --check`, and full tests passed (`186 passed, 3 skipped` at that point). The existing helper needed no change.
- Search rebuild improvements and migration `0042` remain valid: benchmark median 2.41s/p95 2.88s; relevant suites passed.

- `mypy ledgerly/billing/invoices.py` currently fails at `build_invoice_lines` because it returns `Any`; resolve without changing calculations, then run focused tests, mypy, Ruff, and full tests.
- Before review, rebase onto `origin/main` and squash at 12 commits or readiness. Current feature target is `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; pin new licensing tools exactly in `requirements/license-tools.txt`.
